_comment: Schema 3.7 skeleton. Replace every FIXME value, then run: lint_input.py <file>  ->  fix_hashes.py <file>  ->  revenue_forecast.py <file> --validate-only.  Optional revenue_basis note: each historical_revenue record may carry revenue_basis (rf-revenue-basis/1) with operations (total|continuing|discontinued), statement_status (as_reported|restated), optional period_kind (fiscal_year only on the annual history), optional input_quantity (DU5 conversion of the raw disclosed value/unit to the document unit) and optional components (continuing+discontinued exact-value claims that must Decimal-reconcile to the total). Undeclared records keep legacy numeric behavior. Verified comparability needs a shared business_boundary_id/comparison_group_id and basis_claim_ids targeting existing policy_support claims for each observation. The base must match the reported parameter revenue_basis; an undeclared reported parameter means operations=total.
